inputs: benchmarks/independent_cohort_freeze.json commits all six FASTAs, matches, weights, masks, correspondence and public source receipts. Verify each input by SHA-256 before fitting. Stage root results/public-experimental/independent-cohorts/{rnap,ribosome}/.

pair_scores.subjects: All admitted observations, positive weights. First FASTA entry supplies only coordinates. No additional row filters or refitting of masks. Both the full reference Cartesian and frozen retained-site denominators are required.
pair_scores.columns: Use every registered retained reference position, canonical fraction at least 0.8 and at least two canonical states by unweighted assembly counts.
pair_scores.support: Require at least ceil(0.5*N) positive-weight, jointly canonical assemblies per pair (RNAP 231, ribosome 82), inclusive. min_valid_weight=0. Report support count and mass, Kish effective depth and phylum coverage. Treat ambiguous states/gaps as missing.
pair_scores.mi: Native uncorrected empirical, pair-complete categorical MI in bits, no pseudocount. Native APC within each full retained AB, AC or BC block on finite raw scores, before labels.
pair_scores.baseline: Raw MI is the original pair-only marginal-association baseline. Compare MI-APC to raw MI, raw mfDCA to raw MI, DCA-APC to MI-APC and each method to class prevalence (AP) or 0.5 (AUROC); paired differences on identical coordinates.

resources.limits: Native primal/dual dimension 4096; dual N*D <= 16000000. Host 31.1 GiB physical, 16 logical CPUs. Budget 6 GiB for numerical fitting in one process, at most 4 BLAS threads, 2 hours wall per full method/cohort/weight setting. Both full fits pass the fixed input-dimensional guard. Run all four full fit settings. Resource plans exclude interpreter/BLAS and structural reporting.
resources.failure: Use a smaller panel only if native preflight exceeds a fixed limit, documented memory exhaustion persists on a single-process retry, or the 2-hour limit actually expires. An unavailable score or weak enrichment never triggers fallback. If necessary choose at most 160 retained sites per role using indices floor(j*(L-1)/(m-1)) for j=0..m-1, m=min(160,L); include singleton directly. Apply same coordinates to both weight settings, run all methods and recompute APC, explicitly mark secondary restricted estimand. Keep any completed full MI and mfDCA results; no mixing full and fallback for paired differences. Numeric/software error without resource evidence is an error, not a panel selector.

rnap.source: Deposited E. coli O157:H7 alpha/beta/beta-prime homologs; preregistered K-12 coordinate axes are identical over all three full polymer sequences.

ribosome.source: Assembly-1 label asym IDs and operator 1. Other asymmetric-unit repeats are outside the registered assembly. uL5 deposition aligned at 177/179 K-12 coordinates.

labels.mapping: Use source registration positive alignment score, >=25% identity, >=60% unique reference coverage; register and report >=30%/70% correspondence sensitivity. Use unique resolved residues with positive-occupancy heavy atoms per native Phase2 altloc policy. Unknown if reference/residue correspondence or coordinate observation is missing. Abstain if named entity/copy or co-membership is ambiguous. Archive official RCSB mmCIF URL, SHA, assembly, model and mapping diagnostics.
labels.negative: Every jointly observable pair beyond the inclusive cutoff is a natural negative. Secondary distance-separated control at primary cutoff uses positives <=8 and negatives >=25 Angstrom, omitting the intermediate band. It has a separate denominator. Distances may be threshold-classified exactly by neighbor search without storing every far distance.
labels.comparison: Per copy, report reference/retained/finite/observable and joint common counts, positive and negative counts, prevalence. Compare all four scores on exactly the same observed finite pairs per interface; repeat on the corresponding intersection across all copies and across the two weight settings. Compare each weight's own finite-only top list before observing labels. Record per-interface and pooled AB/AC/BC tie-grouped AP and AUROC plus equal-interface macro mean and number defined. Constant-label or empty cases are undefined, alongside their support; report AP and AUROC explicitly for degenerate strata. Pool scores in their native units within each method, no per-interface rescaling.
labels.ranking: Rank all finite pairs before label masking, descending score then pair AB/AC/BC then ascending original coordinates. Report cumulative top 10 and 50 known positives/negatives/unknowns, lower positive/n and upper (positive+unknown)/n, per interface and pooled. Aggregate paired improvements over the predeclared baselines on identical common denominators. No tuning by contact outcomes.
labels.uncertainty: Summarize interface/macro, copy and system ranges descriptively. The two RNAP alpha copies share beta/beta-prime. The two public sequence systems share 139 assemblies. No IID residue-pair or copy confidence intervals or cross-system population CI. Family-level sample size two; report lack of power for transfer. Multi-copy 5S assemblies were excluded in screening; inference applies to admitted annotated single-locus lineages.

nested.source_axes: All full reference axes, including sites outside the pair-ranking mask. Choose floor(L/3), floor(2L/3), one-based. No data-dependent replacement.
nested.graph: Six fields and all 15 pairs, including within-role terms, in both models. Augment with all eight ABC combinations of the two coordinates per role. Uniform inclusion of candidates, zero score-based or functional prioritization.
nested.folds: Hold out every single GTDB phylum with >=8 preregistered observations and >=24 outside, otherwise keep that phylum as training material for other folds. RNAP 22 eligible phyla; ribosome 9. Within each train split fit state pooling on positive panel-complete train rows only; training-only support applies independently per setting. Score the exact same complete heldout rows for the pair and pair-plus-K models. Record every attempted fold, exclusions, train/test positive complete counts, weight and Kish. At least one evaluable heldout observation, finite losses and two converged models required; no substitute if unavailable.
nested.estimand: Heldout conditional log-loss(pair) minus log-loss(pair+K), nats/site, including zero and negative values. For each cohort/setting report per phylum, row-weighted aggregate and equal-phylum aggregate; report intended/evaluable fold and row denominators. Empirical 95% percentile intervals for equal-phylum mean by resampling evaluable paired phylum means, 2000 replicates PCG64 seed 731903. Descriptive conditional-on-fits uncertainty with overlapping training data.
nested.controls: Use primary uniform weights. First preserve each full component vector but break matching within each phylum. Sort its assembly IDs by SHA256(UTF8('matched-negative-v1/'+id)), keep A fixed, assign B and C from cyclic offsets +1 and +2 (mod n); record unchanged/small groups. Second shuffle canonical, nonmissing residues independently per panel column within each phylum at fixed masks. Sort assembly IDs lexically, use NumPy PCG64 seed 731904; iterate phyla lexically, then roles A/B/C then ascending sites. Refit both models on each fixed control table using exactly the real splits; aggregate likewise. Each is one deterministic negative-control realization (not an empirical p-value). Report controls separately. Exact parametric null_draws=0, bootstrap 2000 as above.

fluorescence.primary: Use authors' final combined blue/red brightness phenotype y-bar, after their assay/channel normalization, nonlinear adjustment and regularization at zero. Use supplied processed brightness from Supplementary Data 3 (41467_2019_12130_MOESM7_ESM.xlsx) or the exact author-supplied equivalent in Supplementary Software. Supplementary Data 4 (MOESM8) is the independent measurement replicate: report separately if the same final scale is identifiable. A raw enrichment or single color is a different response. No outcome-guided transformation. If final response cannot be identified, declare unavailable.
fluorescence.analysis: Use parent registration complete 8192-genotype factorial, degree 1, 2 and 3 with intercept, all terms OLS. Use fixed-order author genotype bitstrings, hash SHA256 of ASCII bits modulo 5 within each Hamming-weight stratum; record counts/stratum/fold. Aggregate out-of-fold RMSE and R-squared across all genotypes and compare degree 2 with degree 3 on the same folds. On the complete cube report degree-three Walsh sum of squared orthonormal ±1 coefficients divided by total nonconstant Walsh variation. Degree-truncated prediction and full-cube descriptive variance are distinct. Report ambiguity, missing or duplicate genotypes and undefined measures. Single-protein fluorescence is a separate assay.
